# Site notes What each site actually answers, observed with plain HTTP and the project's User-Agent, at least four seconds apart per site (ten for BaSIA). None of these interfaces is documented; they are what each site's own search page sends. Observed 2026-10-11, about 60 requests in all. ## Geneteka (geneteka.genealodzy.pl) ### Coverage list: `GET /rejestry.php?lang=pol` - One HTML page, 2.46 MB, answered in 1.3 s. No cookie needed. - A table with one row per region: name, number of parishes, number of registers, then every register as `Kraków WNMP (Mariacki) 1687-1909 U;`. `class` is B (births), S (marriages) or D (deaths). `title` holds the years indexed; the `` after it only the first and last. - 16,093 registers in 21 regions on the day. - Years are shortened to the digits that change: `1741-55,90,98,1810-1930` is 1741-1755, 1790, 1798 and 1810-1930. A `title` can be empty: the register is listed with no years. - A register is named by its parish, sometimes with a qualifier in parentheses (`(mojż.)` Jewish, `(ewang.)` Protestant, `(gr.-kat.)` Greek Catholic) or a suffix (`USC` civil registry). ### Search: `GET /api/getAct.php` - Query: `draw=1&start=&length=50&op=gt&lang=pol&bdm=&w=&rid=&search_lastname=&search_name=&search_lastname2=&search_name2=&from_date=&to_date=`, plus `exac=1` for an exact surname. - The page's own JavaScript sends `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` and a Referer of the matching `index.php?...` page; the server does the same. - The answer is DataTables JSON served as `text/html; charset=UTF-8`: `{"draw", "recordsTotal", "recordsFiltered", "data": [...], "parishes": {...}}`. - `parishes` names the registers searched: `{"06mp": [[8959, "Kraków WNMP (Mariacki)", "0.0", "małopolskie"]]}`, or `[]` when a whole region was searched. - Without `exac`, Kowalski also matched Kowalska and Kowalewska, in any name column (the child's, the mother's, "other surnames"). - A births or deaths row has nine cells before the last: year, entry, given name, surname, father, mother's given name, mother's surname, parish, place. A marriages row: year, entry, groom's given name and surname, groom's parents, bride's given name and surname, bride's parents, parish. - A name cell can carry its own note: `Jakubowski`. - The last cell is HTML. `i.png`'s title holds the indexer's notes, separated by ` ` ("Uwagi: Skan 116", "Data ślubu: 18.11.1860 r."); `z.png`'s title names the custodian ("Miejsce przechowywania ksiąg: Archiwum Narodowe w Krakowie 30-960 Kraków, ul. Sienna 16") inside a link to its website; `a.png` names the indexer; an `s.png` link is the scan (here a Szukaj w Archiwach unit page); `fix.php?gid=N` is the correction form, and `gid` is the entry's id. - A search with no matches answers `recordsTotal: 0` and still names the registers searched. - `robots.txt`: `User-agent: *`, an empty `Disallow`, `Crawl-delay: 120`, `Disallow: /cgi-bin/`. ## The Poznań Project (poznan-project.psnc.pl) ### The form: `GET /` - The extended-search form's `groom_firstname` and `bride_firstname` selects hold the name groups: 52 for grooms and 50 for brides on the day, each a number and a label such as `25` = "Joannes / Jan / Johann" or `1` = "Adalbert(us) / Wojciech". `0` is any; `99` is "none of the above". - Parentheses mark optional letters: `Apol(l)onia`, `Maria(nna)`. ### Results: `POST /getresults.php` - Form: `action=extended&extended_window_lastname_mode=&groom_firstname=&groom_lastname=&bride_firstname=&bride_lastname=&lastname=&parish_id=&parish_distance=&year_from=&year_to=&last_update=&confession=<0-3>&threshold=<50-100>`, with `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`. Each search took about 6 s (5.3 s of it the site's own query time). - An HTML fragment: a statistics box ("Wyniki zgodne: 37", "Wyniki powyżej progu 80%: 46"), then one block per marriage, each starting `
`. - A block's `

` (or `rough1`) holds the register type ("Parafia katolicka"), the parish in ``, and "wpis 5 / 1850". The groom and bride are `
  • ` and `
  • `, or `groom_widow` and `bride_widow`, with age, parents and "Dodatkowe informacje". A similarity bar `bar80.gif` is rounded to tens; the figure after it ("81%") is exact. - User comments are `
  • ` with the author's name and often an e-mail address. The server keeps only the comment and its date. - "Akt oryginalny" links `pages/arch_location/archN.htm`, a fixed page saying who holds the original register ("The original record for this marriage is held in the State Archive in Włocławek, Poland."). Pages 1 to 40 were read on the day; there are more. - **Too many matches:** Kowalski as groom, 1850-1855, any given name, matched 323 exactly and 452 above the threshold. The answer then holds the statistics, "Zbyt duża liczba wyników. Ogranicz kryteria wyszukiwania…" and a map of parishes, and no entries. - **No matches:** "Nie znaleziono pasujących zapisów". - No `robots.txt` (404). ## BaSIA (www.basia.famula.pl) ### Search: `POST /en/` - The extended-search form, as the page posts it: `p_count=&od=&do=&placename=&distance=&type_unit=&type_record=&datefrom=2011-01-28&dateto=&showplaces=&showtype=block&showdate=none&search_ext=szukaj&search_ext_button=Search`, and for each person `fname`, `lname`, `sex`, `type`, `sim` from 0. `type_record` a, b, c are birth, marriage, death. - The answer is a whole page (490 KB for 104 entries), answered in about 2 s. Entries are grouped by map area in `resgroup` blocks; each is `
    `, with a left box (`lbox`: register, record type, year, book, people with a similarity bar per name, "Indexer notes", "Other people appearing in the document") and a right box (`rbox`: archive, call number and scan, indexer, date added, ID, links). - The archive link is `showbox.php?id=`: the archive's number (11 AP Kalisz, 53 AP Poznań, 54 its Konin branch) or a short code (AAP, the archdiocesan archive in Poznań). - The scan link is usually `https://www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/jednostka/-/jednostka/#scan`, with the text "772/1/19, scan 122". 2 of 104 entries on the day linked the retired `https://szukajwarchiwach.pl/11/730/0/1/25/str/1/4/15/#select53` instead. Parish entries held at the archdiocesan archive carry a call number ("PM 015/7") and no link. - The unit page for "772/1/19, scan 122" (opened in a browser) gave the Sygnatura 11/772/0/1/19: here BaSIA's series number matched. It does not always. - The total is in the map legend's script: "wszystkie pasujące wpisy: 104". - **More than 250 matches:** Kowalski, 1800-1900, matched 43,684; the page lists the first 250 and says "Wyników jest więcej niż 250…" in `

    `, and "The number of search results exceeded maximum value." - **No matches:** "No search results for your query". - Each entry has a permalink `/record/`, whose decoded form is `_____…____`. - `robots.txt`: a comment (in Polish) that robots may index information pages but not the search or the data scripts, since each search is a costly database query; `Crawl-delay: 10`; `Disallow` for `/search.php`, `/search_ajax.php`, `/getjson.php`, `/getcsv.php`, `/show_record.php`, `/skany.php` and others. `/en/` is not disallowed. ## Szukaj w Archiwach ### Unit pages: `www.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/jednostka/-/jednostka/` - Behind Imperva (Incapsula); built for a browser. **Not fetched by this server.** Opened once in a browser on the day: the page for AP Kalisz 11/772/0/1/19 (Żerków civil registry, births 1880) showed its Sygnatura, dates and 219 scans, and each scan's image address carries its 64-character hex name. Another unit page answered "Portlety jest tymczasowo niedostępny" (the portlet is temporarily unavailable), as the portal often does. ### Photo host: `GET https://photos.szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl/_max` - Open: no cookie, no challenge. Served through Imperva's CDN (`x-cdn: Imperva`), which sets cookies the server does not need. - `_max` is the full-size scan: 3500 x 2393 px, 647 KB for a microfilm target card (scan 1 of the unit above). - **A name it does not hold** answers 200 with `image/jpeg`: a 379 x 273, 12,137-byte picture reading "PLIK NIEDOSTĘPNY" (SHA-256 `6fbf02e0…3f562c`). The server refuses it. - `robots.txt` answers 400 (an object-store error).
